# truenas_zvol (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS zvol by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full zvol path, e.g. tank/myvol.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `compression` (String)
- `copies` (Number)
- `dedup` (String)
- `encrypted` (Boolean)
- `encryption` (Boolean)
- `encryption_algorithm` (String)
- `encryption_generate_key` (Boolean)
- `encryption_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `encryption_passphrase` (String, Sensitive)
- `guid` (String) ZFS guid of the zvol (stable across renames).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inherit_encryption` (Boolean)
- `key_format` (String)
- `locked` (Boolean)
- `origin` (String) Snapshot the zvol was cloned from, null when it is not a clone.
- `pool` (String)
- `readonly` (String)
- `refreservation` (Number)
- `reservation` (Number)
- `snapdev` (String)
- `sparse` (Boolean)
- `sync` (String)
- `volblocksize` (Number)
- `volsize` (Number)
